$comment: The fire tile's feel (ticket 314; #309 Gameplay touch input, the TD on #314): a press that neither drags nor lets go within holdFireTicks (a quarter second) becomes a held gun that fires on each tick the recovery allows; a drag of dragAimPixels from the press aims instead, and fires on release; a quick tap fires along the facing on release. A refused shot clanks with refusalClank, a single voice shaped like the kernel's light clank (square at 140 Hz, a band of noise at 1200 Hz), since the clank means a blocked shot; the recovery never clanks. Starting values for G&V, checked by ear in npm run dev.
